title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Completed Energy Systems Load Forecasting analysis. Analyzed 672 records of 15-minute load data (Jan 1-7, 2026). Generated 8 figures showing time series, daily profiles, hourly patterns, load distribution, day-of-week effects, peak analysis, and forecast performance. Key findings: mean load 119.9 MW, max 135.3 MW, 24h lag forecast MAPE 4.68%. Report saved to report/report.md with methodology, results, figures, and reliability recommendations.
